title: Among male superheroes with blue hair, find those who have more than 10 sup
question: Among male superheroes with blue hair, find those who have more than 10 superpowers and rank them by their speed attribute in ascending order. Return their full names, number of superpowers, and speed rank.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_018 AS id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
         COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count,
         ha.XCL_011 AS speed
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
  JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005
  JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Male' AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue' AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
  GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, ha.XCL_011
  HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > 10
)
SELECT full_name, power_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY speed ASC) AS speed_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY speed ASC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_018 AS id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
         COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count,
         ha.XCL_011 AS speed
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
  JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005
  JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Male' AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue' AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
  GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, ha.XCL_011
  HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > 10
)
SELECT full_name, power_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY speed ASC) AS speed_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY speed ASC
